summary: Quiet residential kerb, houses 11-22 m away; flatter toward the east corner.

drivers.seclusion: Front gardens and houses 12-15 m from the kerb on this side, more homes opposite.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide sealed street with cars parked both sides; room for a van.
drivers.traffic: Quiet local street; side street junction at the east end.
drivers.convention: Some cars park on the kerb; no sign of overnight vans.

flags: Steep at west end: about 10% over the first 30 m
sun_shade: Street trees give patchy shade; open to morning and afternoon sun.

best_section.where: South kerb, mid-block approaching the side-street corner
